name: Create DLFS File
description: Create a new file in a DLFS drive. Fails if the target already exists. Omit content to create an empty file. When supplied, content is the standard asset content descriptor: inline UTF-8 text, any resolvable ref, or a sha256 blob from content storage; sha256 alongside inline/ref verifies integrity. Parent directories must exist.
creator: Covia

drive.description: Drive name or authorised DID-scoped drive reference

path.description: Destination within the drive. May be omitted when content.fileName supplies it.

content.description: Optional standard asset content descriptor. Omit it, or supply only fileName/contentType, for an empty file. Add inline, ref, or sha256 for content bytes. content.dlfs remains a compatibility alias for ref.

inline.description: UTF-8 text held directly in the descriptor

ref.description: Any resolvable content reference, including assets, lattice paths, file:// paths, DLFS paths, and DID URLs

dlfs.description: Compatibility alias for ref used by existing asset metadata

sha256.description: Content-store hash when used alone, or an integrity pin for inline/ref content

fileName.description: Original file name; also supplies the destination when path is omitted

ref.description: Canonical DLFS reference to the created file

contentType.description: Declared or resolved media type, when known
